title: 第一章 工藤新一回来了？那我是谁？
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

我是高中生侦探工藤新一，昨天晚上我和青梅竹马的小兰去游乐场玩……前略、中间略、后略，总之从昨晚开始，我寄宿在了糊涂侦探毛利小五郎的家里。

一大早，曾用名工藤新一、现用名江户川柯南的七岁小屁孩，把下巴搁在事务所的窗台上，看着窗下的街道人来人往，就是没有一个人打算带着案件上门来委托毛利小五郎。同时在心里复盘着自己昨晚那惊奇的可以画成漫画刊登在《周刊少年Sunday》的经历，好端端一个高中生，眼睛一闭一睁就变成了小学生，然后被青梅竹马‘收养’了。

有小兰这样温柔善良还可爱的青梅竹马，大概是自己这辈子最幸运的一件事了……

正想着，柯南听到了楼上开门的声音，过了几秒钟，事务所的门被推开，毛利兰探头进来：“爸爸，柯南，我出去一趟。”

“大清早的，你做什么去啊。”因为昨晚的社长千金被绑架事件忙活到了后半夜，无精打采的趴在办公桌上发呆的毛利小五郎抬起头，用惺忪的眼神看着女儿。

“我要去新一家看看，他到底回来了没有，从昨晚到现在，这家伙的电话一直打不通。”撂下一句话，小兰转身就要出门了。

昨天晚上她去工藤家找工藤新一并没有找到，虽然捡到了一只柯南转移了一下注意力，但回过神来还是很担心失联的工藤新一，所以再去看看他回家没有。

“小兰……姐姐，额……”柯南第一反应是想要叫住小兰，并告诉她不用去了，工藤新一肯定不在家。但刚开口了才意识到，‘江户川柯南’凭什么断言‘工藤新一’不在家呢？

“怎么了，柯南？”

“……那个，我也想和你一起去！”最后柯南改了口，跑出门追上了小兰。

“柯南这么粘着我啊。”毛利兰并没有注意到柯南的前后语气变化，只当做小孩子喜欢粘着自己，或者一个人和爸爸相处有些不安，所以温柔地牵起柯南的手，结伴走向工藤家。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

I am high school detective Kudo Shinichi. Last night I went to the amusement park with my childhood sweetheart Ran... First, middle, and last. In short, starting last night, I stayed at the home of the confused detective Mouri Kogoro.

Early in the morning, the seven-year-old kid who used to be named Kudo Shinichi and is now known as Edogawa Conan rested his chin on the window sill of the office and looked at the people coming and going on the street below the window, but no one was planning to come to entrust Mouri Kogoro with a case.At the same time, I was replaying in my mind the amazing experience I had last night that could be drawn into a comic and published in "Weekly Shōnen Sunday". A high school student turned into an elementary school student as soon as he closed and opened his eyes, and was then 'adopted' by his childhood sweetheart.

Having a childhood sweetheart like Xiaolan who is gentle, kind and cute is probably the luckiest thing in my life...

Just as he was thinking about it, Conan heard the sound of the door opening upstairs. After a few seconds, the door of the office was pushed open, and Mao Lilan poked his head in: "Dad, Conan, I'm going out for a while."

"It's so early in the morning, what are you doing?" Mouri Kogoro, who was lying listlessly on his desk in a daze after working until midnight because of the kidnapping of the president's daughter last night, raised his head and looked at his daughter with hesitant eyes.

"I'm going to Xinjia to see if he's back. From last night to now, this guy's phone has been unreachable." After saying this, Xiaolan turned around and was about to go out.

Last night, she went to Kudo's house to look for Kudo Shinichi but did not find him. Although she picked up a Conan to divert her attention, she was still worried about the missing Kudo Shinichi when she came back to her senses, so she went to see if he had returned home.

"Xiaolan...sister, uh..." Conan's first reaction was to call Xiaolan and tell her that she didn't need to go. Kudo Shinichi was definitely not at home.But as soon as I spoke, I realized, why did 'Edogawa Conan' claim that 'Kudo Shinichi' was not at home?

"What's wrong, Conan?"

"...Well, I want to go with you too!" Conan finally changed his mind and ran out the door to catch up with Xiaolan.

"Conan is so clingy to me." Mao Lilan didn't notice the change in Conan's tone. She just thought it was a child who liked to cling to herself, or was a little uneasy being with his father alone, so she gently held Conan's hand and walked to Kudo's house together.
